description: Campus maintenance and issue-reporting system for Sherubtse College.
features: Home page and About Us page
Supporting staff and non-supporting staff dashboard
Issue reporting and status updates for staff roles
Separate Unit / Club / Network private feedback page
Recipient dropdown for IT Department, Dean of Academic Affairs, Dean of Student Affairs, President and Fina President
Private recipient-specific feedback inbox with search and status updates
Separate feedback.json storage, independent of regular maintenance issues
High-contrast responsive styles for the feedback form and inbox

Separate private dashboards: DAA Dashboard (Dean of Academic Affairs), IT Department Dashboard and DSA Dashboard (Dean of Student Affairs); each shows only complaints addressed to that office and opens only for the designated email in .env
Fina President dashboard, and a response form on every office dashboard (Fina President, DAA, IT Department, DSA); senders read the responses under 'My complaints & responses' on their own dashboard
President account type and President Dashboard (/president/dashboard), same layout and response form as the other office dashboards

email_rules.student: Eight digits followed by .sherubtse@rub.edu.bt, for example 07240073.sherubtse@rub.edu.bt
email_rules.faculty_and_staff: College username followed by .sherubtse@rub.edu.bt, for example name.sherubtse@rub.edu.bt

note: This is a classroom demonstration. The email format is validated, but email ownership is not verified with a confirmation email. Use a database, email verification, CSRF protection, rate limiting and secure production session settings before deployment.
feedback_note: Recipient emails in .env are example addresses. Replace them with official accounts before use. The inbox is restricted by signed-in email matching the configured recipient address. Since this demo validates email format but does not verify ownership, use institutional email verification before production.
